description: Four sheet breaks in six hours at the second press. Wet streaks along the tending-side edge before each break. Felt permeability check showed the second press bottom felt well below target.
suspected_cause: Felt filling up with pitch and stickies from the recycled furnish.
root_cause: Bottom felt plugged with pitch and stickies. High-pressure shower nozzles were partly blocked, so the felt was not being cleaned on the run.
action_taken: Cleared the shower nozzles, ran an off-line caustic felt wash and increased the felt conditioning chemical. Felt changed at the next planned shutdown.

description: Shift B: web brk x4 after PR2. Moist streak TS edge. Uhle box vac dropping, fabric looks glazed and tight. Ran F/W, ok for now.
suspected_cause: Fabric loaded up, uhle box not drawing.
root_cause: HP shower header choked, fabric not conditioned.
action_taken: Pulled and rodded HP shower nozzles, chem wash on fabric.

description: Holes and spots appearing in the sheet, followed by breaks at the size press. Lab found slime deposits in the machine chest and on the headbox walls.
suspected_cause: Microbiological growth in the wet-end system.
root_cause: Biocide dosing pump had tripped three days earlier with no alarm configured, so biofilm built up in the short circulation.
action_taken: Restarted the dosing pump, shock-dosed biocide, boiled out the headbox and added a low-flow alarm on the dosing pump.

description: Customer complaint: pinholes and dirt specks on reels 4410 to 4416. Brownish gummy lumps found in the wire pit, sour smell.
suspected_cause: Deposits breaking off somewhere in the wet end.
action_taken: Hand-cleaned the wire pit, extra washup.

description: Basis weight varying by about 3 g/m2 in machine direction, headbox pressure hunting. Unusual rumbling noise from the fan pump.
suspected_cause: Wire pit level run too low.
root_cause: Operator error.
action_taken: Operator retrained on level setpoints; setpoint raised.

description: MD grammage swings, total head unstable, cavitation sound at the fan pump. Wire pit level control valve LV-301 found sticking at 40%.
root_cause: Sticking level control valve let the wire pit level drop, drawing air into the fan pump suction.
action_taken: Replaced the positioner, stroke-tested the valve, added a deviation alarm on wire pit level.

area_or_equipment: Tablet press TP-02, Product A 500 mg
description: In-process control: hardness below limit and capping seen on 6 of 20 tablets. Batch placed on hold. Compression force within range.
root_cause: Fluid bed dryer inlet air temperature probe read 6 C low, so the dryer ran hotter than its set point. Granule LOD 0.6% against a specification of 1.5 to 3.0%.
action_taken: Probe replaced and calibrated. Granule LOD check added before compression. Batch reworked under an approved protocol.

description: Friability failed, tabs laminating with the top layer splitting off. Upstream LOD on granules very low. FBD-1 temp trend looked normal on the HMI.
root_cause: FBD-1 inlet temperature sensor drifted out of calibration.
action_taken: Sensor recalibrated, calibration interval shortened from 12 to 6 months.

description: Grade A non-viable particle counts (0.5 um) exceeded the alert limit three times during filling, each during a glove-port intervention.
root_cause: Pinhole in the glove at port 4. Glove integrity test was a week overdue.
action_taken: Glove replaced and all gloves tested. Glove test schedule moved into the maintenance system with reminders. QA assessed batch impact.

description: Settle plate at position 3 grew 1 CFU in Grade A, identified as skin flora. The plate sits next to the barrier arm port used for line clearance.
root_cause: Operator technique. Operator retrained on aseptic behaviour.
action_taken: Retraining completed.

description: Relative humidity rose to 71% for nine hours overnight. Alarm was sent but not acknowledged until the morning shift.
root_cause: Steam humidifier solenoid valve stuck open. Alarm escalation went to a shared inbox nobody watches out of hours.
action_taken: Valve replaced. Alarm escalation changed to the on-call phone. Impact on stability samples assessed.

description: Monday logger download: RH spike to 74% on Saturday night, temp OK. Water pooling under the steam unit.
action_taken: Maintenance called, unit inspected.

area_or_equipment: PM1 dryer section, third dryer group
description: Moisture streaks across the sheet at the reel scanner. Two cans in the third dryer group read cold on the infrared gun and the differential pressure across the group had dropped.
suspected_cause: Condensate not being removed from some cans.
root_cause: Rotary syphons in cans 3-14 and 3-16 had broken loose, so the cans were flooding with condensate.
action_taken: Replaced both syphons at a short stop and added an alarm on dryer group 3 differential pressure.

description: Wet bands on reel scanner, can 3-12 cold, thumping noise from DG3. dP low.
root_cause: Syphon elbow cracked in can 3-12.
action_taken: Syphon replaced at shut.

description: Chatter marks across the sheet at regular spacing; customer print trials show banding. Doctor blade on the top calender roll vibrating.
root_cause: Blade holder worn and blade angle wrong after the last blade change.
action_taken: Holder refurbished, blade angle set to specification, blade-change checklist updated.

description: Barring marks every ~30 cm on reel, doctor on top roll chattering loud.
action_taken: Changed blade, loaded lighter.

description: Tensile and burst strength trending down over two weeks while refiner specific energy held steady. Freeness above target.
root_cause: Refiner plates worn beyond their limit; bar edges rounded.
action_taken: Plates changed. Plate life now tracked by tonnage refined.

description: CSF creeping up, burst low on QC, R2 amps normal. Plates at ~1.2x rated tonnage.
root_cause: Worn refiner plates.
action_taken: Plates changed at shut.

description: Customer rolls telescoping in transit, three complaints this week. Roll hardness readings uneven across the set.
root_cause: Unwind brake pads worn and the tension controller hunting.
action_taken: Brake pads replaced and tension loop retuned.

description: Soft rolls + telescoping on set 22-7, Rho meter low at edges. Tension swinging on unwind.
action_taken: Brake pads checked, adjusted.

description: Sheet broke at the reel during turn-up three times on night shift. Tail not transferring cleanly onto the new spool.
root_cause: Turn-up air shower nozzle knocked out of line during a spool change.
action_taken: Nozzle realigned and locked; position mark added.

description: High vibration alarm on the first press bottom roll; drive-side bearing temperature up to 85 C.
root_cause: Bearing lubrication line blocked, bearing running dry.
action_taken: Lube line cleared; bearing replaced at the next shutdown.

description: Holes in the sheet repeating every 10.5 m, which matches the forming fabric length. No slime found in the wet end.
root_cause: Small tear in the forming fabric next to the seam.
action_taken: Tear patched; fabric changed at the next shutdown.

description: Cross-direction basis weight streak, 4 g/m2 heavy at profile position 112, steady in the machine direction. Slice lip actuator at that position not responding.
root_cause: Slice lip actuator motor failed.
action_taken: Actuator replaced.

description: Clarifier outlet suspended solids above the discharge consent limit for six hours; sludge blanket rising.
root_cause: Sludge recirculation pump tripped and no alarm reached the control room.
action_taken: Pump restarted, alarm routed to the control room, regulator informed.

description: Liquid ring vacuum pump VP-2 tripped on overload. Couch vacuum dropped and sheet dryness after the press fell.
root_cause: Seal water isolation valve left closed after maintenance, so the pump ran hot.
action_taken: Valve reopened, seal water flow switch added with a trip alarm.

description: Pulper rotor jammed with bale wire; pulper stopped.
root_cause: Bale wire cutter jammed, so wires went into the pulper with the bales.
action_taken: Rotor cleared, wire cutter repaired.

description: Dryer hood dew point high; condensation dripping onto the sheet, causing wet spots and two breaks.
root_cause: Exhaust fan drive belts slipping.
action_taken: Belts replaced and tensioned.

description: TOC on the return loop rose to 420 ppb against an alert limit of 400 ppb. Conductivity normal.
root_cause: 185 nm UV lamp at end of life; lamp hours were not being tracked.
action_taken: Lamp replaced, lamp-hour counter added to the maintenance schedule, use points sampled.

description: TOC alarm on PW return, 450 ppb. UV unit showing lamp intensity low warning since last week.
root_cause: UV lamp intensity low.
action_taken: Lamp replaced.

description: Blue dye leak test failed on 3 of 20 blisters, dye ingress at the cavity edge. Sealing temperature display normal.
root_cause: One sealing plate heater element failing; actual temperature 15 C below the set point.
action_taken: Heater replaced; independent temperature check added at line start-up.

description: Dye test fail, 2/20 leakers, both on operator-side lane. Sealing temp reads OK on HMI.
action_taken: Raised sealing temp 5 C, retest passed.

description: Bowie-Dick test failed, uneven colour change in the centre of the sheet. Chamber vacuum leak rate test also marginal.
root_cause: Worn door gasket let air in during the pre-vacuum pulses.
action_taken: Gasket replaced, leak test passed, loads since the last pass assessed.

description: Daily B-D fail, pale centre. Leak test 1.6 mbar/min (limit 1.3).
action_taken: Gasket ordered, autoclave out of service.

area_or_equipment: Grade C corridor to Grade B airlock
description: Differential pressure alarm: cascade fell from 15 Pa to 4 Pa for 20 minutes. Production in Grade B paused.
root_cause: AHU-4 supply fan belt broke.
action_taken: Belt replaced, spare belts stocked, vibration monitoring added.

description: dP low alarm AL-2, 3 Pa, door interlock OK, supply airflow low on BMS.
root_cause: Fan belt worn and slipping.
action_taken: Belts changed.

description: Tablet weight variation out of limits (RSD 3.1%). Hardness normal, no capping. Feed frame paddle speed fluctuating.
root_cause: Feed frame drive coupling loose.
action_taken: Coupling replaced and torqued.

description: Sticking and picking on the upper punch faces, logo infill on tablets. Granule LOD at the top of the range.
root_cause: Granules too wet (LOD 3.4%) combined with worn punch faces.
action_taken: Punches polished, drying end point tightened.

area_or_equipment: Aseptic filling line 1, Grade B area
description: Operator glove print on exit from Grade B grew 6 CFU on the right hand, above the limit of 5 CFU. No Grade A excursions.
root_cause: Sanitiser dispenser in the airlock was empty.
action_taken: Dispenser refilled and added to the area start-up checks.

description: Temperature rose to 28.5 C for four hours while RH stayed in range. Compressor short-cycling.
root_cause: Refrigerant leak at a flare joint.
action_taken: Leak repaired and system recharged; sample impact assessed.

description: Temperature reached 11 C for 50 minutes after a delivery; door found ajar.
root_cause: Door closer broken and no door-open alarm fitted.
action_taken: Closer repaired and door-open alarm added.

description: Twinning and sticking of tablets during film coating; spray rate at the upper limit.
root_cause: Pan speed set too low after a recipe edit.
action_taken: Recipe corrected under change control.

description: Filter bag torn; granule fines found in the exhaust duct. Yield 4% low.
root_cause: Filter bag used past its replacement interval.
action_taken: Bag replaced; replacement interval added to the maintenance system.

description: Superseded label version issued to packaging line 2; caught at line clearance.
root_cause: Superseded labels had not been removed from the store.
action_taken: Superseded stock quarantined and destroyed; label issue now checks version.

description: Press stopped on E-104 punch tight at station 17 in the middle of the batch. Upper punch hard to turn by hand, fines packed in the upper punch guide.
root_cause: Fines built up in the upper punch guide of station 17.
action_taken: Cleaned the station 17 punch and guide with IPA, oiled the punch and restarted.

description: E-104 punch tight again on station 17 and then 18, same as last month. W-212 compression force warnings had been rising for two shifts before the stop.
root_cause: Upper punch guide bushing at station 17 worn: go/no-go gauge G-19 did not pass, so fines kept getting in. Cleaning alone did not hold.
action_taken: Replaced guide bushing RTP-BS-07 and the upper punch at station 17, cleaned station 18. Supervisor now reviews W-212 counts every shift.

description: Main drive tripped on overload E-221 right after the product changeover. Compression force readings far above the maximum for the tooling.
root_cause: Tablet thickness set too low for the new product, causing over-compression.
action_taken: Motor cooled, relay F3 reset, thickness corrected to the batch record value, restarted at 20 rpm.

description: E-31 forming heater temp low, machine stopped. Blister pockets coming out shallow before the stop.
root_cause: Heater cartridge no. 3 in the lower forming plate open circuit.
action_taken: Replaced heater cartridge BPM-HC-250 and re-seated the thermocouple. Pocket depth checked on 10 strips.

description: Forming temp dropping to 110 C now and then, E-31 twice in one shift. All heater cartridges read OK on the meter.
root_cause: Thermocouple loose in its bore, reading low.
action_taken: Thermocouple refitted with heat-transfer paste and clamp tightened.

description: Door seal fault E-07 at cycle start, seal pressure not reached and the cycle would not start. Cut in the gasket near the bottom hinge.
root_cause: Door gasket cut near the hinge.
action_taken: Replaced door gasket SA-DG-600 with a thin film of SA-SG-01 grease. Leak test 0.9 mbar/min, Bowie-Dick passed, QA released.

description: Cycle aborted on E-21 drain temperature low during exposure. Load quarantined.
root_cause: Drain strainer ST-2 blocked with scale.
action_taken: Cleaned strainer ST-2 and blew down the trap. Empty cycle held drain above 121 C. Load reprocessed after QA review.

description: Lube pressure low warning W-305 showing for two days without action; then punches started to feel tight at changeover.
root_cause: Central lubrication reservoir nearly empty.
action_taken: Reservoir refilled with RTP-LB-01 and lines purged until pressure above 2 bar.
